name: Jehoahaz
summary: A son of Josiah whom the people made king of Judah when his father was killed. He did evil and reigned only three months before Pharaoh-nechoh put him in chains and took him to Egypt, where he died.

key_moments.title: Made King When Josiah Is Killed
key_moments.description: After Pharaoh-nechoh killed Josiah at Megiddo, the people of the land anointed Jehoahaz king in his father's place. He was twenty-three, reigned three months in Jerusalem, and did evil in the LORD's sight.

key_moments.title: Chained by Pharaoh at Riblah
key_moments.description: Pharaoh-nechoh put Jehoahaz in chains at Riblah so he could not reign, and made the land pay tribute. He put Jehoahaz's brother Eliakim on the throne as Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz to Egypt, where he died.
